peekDesc.zh: 侧栏收起时，鼠标停在侧栏按钮上，侧栏就浮在页面上方展开，主窗口宽度不变；移开鼠标或选中会话后自动收起，点击按钮仍是固定展开。
peekDesc.en: While the sidebar is collapsed, resting the pointer on its toggle opens it over the page and the main window keeps its width; it closes when the pointer leaves or a session is picked, and a click on the toggle still keeps it open.
